للشاملة:: For the comprehensive [subject or book title would follow here].
رضي: May Allāh be pleased with him/her/them.
أن: Indeed, if a person were to perform an obligatory act within it, it would be as if he had performed seventy obligatory acts at other times.
عُرْوَةَ: عُرْوَةَ translates to 'bond' or 'relation' in English.
-ق3أ-: He said, 'Then by the One who sent you, O Allah, did He command you with this?' He said, 'Yes.' He said, 'And your Messenger claims that we have a Hajj to the House for whoever can manage the journey to it.' He said, 'True.' He said, 'Then by the One who sent you, O Allah, did He command you with this?' He said, 'Yes.' Then the man turned away and said, 'And by the One who sent you with the truth, I will neither add anything to them nor reduce anything from them.' The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said, 'If he spoke truly, he will surely enter Paradise. Amen.'
-ق3ب-: He said, 'Then by the One who sent you, O Allah, did He command you with this?' He said, 'Yes.' Then the man turned away and said, 'And by the One who sent you with the truth, I will neither add anything to them nor reduce anything from them.' The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said, 'If he spoke truly, he will surely enter Paradise. Amen.'
